quickstart.description: Build a working movie search app with natural language queries, vector search, and RAG in 5 steps.
quickstart.detailedDescription: The prompt will guide you to create a movie search demo application that uses natural language queries, vector and hybrid search to browse a movie collection.
features: Create a Movie collection with text2vec-weaviate vectorizer
Import 5 sample movies (The Matrix, Inception, The Godfather, Spirited Away, The Dark Knight)
Use the query agent to retrieve information with natural language queries (only Python & TypeScript)
Implement vector, hybrid, and keyword search modes
Add Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) with Anthropic for AI-powered movie explanations

collections-tool-pdf.description: Batch import PDF files into Weaviate Cloud using multi-vector embeddings (ColPali-style), converting each page to a base64-encoded image.
collections-tool-pdf.detailedDescription: The prompt will guide you to create a script that recursively discovers PDF files, renders each page as a base64 image, and imports them into Weaviate Cloud as separate objects with page number, document title, and source file metadata. Uses multi2vec-weaviate with the ColModernVBERT model for multi-vector encoding.
features: Convert each PDF page to a base64-encoded image
Store pages as separate objects with page_number, document_title, and source_file metadata
Recursive directory scanning with customizable glob patterns
Dry-run mode to preview files and page counts without writing to Weaviate
Batch import with error handling — skips failed pages rather than aborting

collections-tool-tabular.description: Batch import CSV and Excel (.xlsx) files into Weaviate Cloud with automatic schema detection, type coercion, and text2vec-weaviate embeddings.
collections-tool-tabular.detailedDescription: The prompt will guide you to create a script that discovers CSV and Excel files, auto-detects column types (INT, NUMBER, BOOLEAN, TEXT), sanitizes property names, validates that all files share the same headers, and batch imports rows into a Weaviate Cloud collection using the Snowflake Arctic Embed model.
features: Support both CSV (RFC 4180) and Excel (.xlsx) file formats
Auto-detect column types: INT, NUMBER, BOOLEAN, TEXT
Sanitize headers into valid Weaviate property names
Validate all files share the same column headers before import
Coerce cell values to detected types; skip empty cells
Recursive directory scanning with customizable glob patterns
Dry-run mode to preview schema without writing to Weaviate
Batch import (size 100) with per-batch error reporting
